Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event

Class VoiceRouteEvent

java.lang.Object
net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.VoiceRouteEvent
public class VoiceRouteEvent extends net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event
A route (the list of listeners) was computed for a talking player. Posted on the server thread about every 2 ticks while the player talks; the route is then used for every frame until the next computation.

Fired after mutes, groups, route hooks and proximity were applied. It is not fired for muted players. Edit getTargets() to add or remove listeners, toggle effects for the route, or cancel the event so nobody hears the player for this route period.

Since:
1.1.0
